extracted.intended_audience: legal researchers, regulatory analysts, and policy scholars interested in types of administrative enforcement and adjudicative proceedings across U.S. federal agencies
extracted.subtask_description: Identify and categorize the kinds of adjudicative/enforcement proceedings reported by U.S. federal agencies (e.g., suspensions, revocations, stop orders, registration actions), often with statutory citations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of proceedings reported by the agencies (general)
rubrics_metrics.description: Header/overall category grouping the various adjudicative and enforcement proceeding types that agencies report (e.g., suspensions, revocations, stop orders, approvals, disbarments).

rubrics_metrics.name: Certificates of convenience & necessity
rubrics_metrics.description: Interstate Commerce Commission: Certificates of convenience & necessity (statutory citations given: 49 USC sections including 511(19), 1(21), 6(11), 305, 909, 1010).

rubrics_metrics.name: Finance and transfer of operating authority
rubrics_metrics.description: Interstate Commerce Commission: Finance and transfer of operating authority (statutory citations: 49 USC 312, 912, 1010).

rubrics_metrics.name: Rates, fares, and charges
rubrics_metrics.description: Interstate Commerce Commission: Proceedings concerning rates, fares, and charges (statutory citations: 49 USC 556(6), 16(1), 906(e), 908(d), 1005).

rubrics_metrics.name: Bankruptcy Act reorganizations (agency-reported)
rubrics_metrics.description: Interstate Commerce Commission: Bankruptcy Act reorganizations (statutory citation given as 11 USC 205 in the table).

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance and rules investigations
rubrics_metrics.description: Interstate Commerce Commission: Compliance and rules investigations (statutory citations: 49 USC 305(e), 312, 904(e), 1010(f)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Stop orders (SA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Securities and Exchange Commission: Stop orders under the Securities Act (SA) with statutory citation 15 USC 77h(d).

rubrics_metrics.name: Revocation or suspension of broker-dealer or exchange member
rubrics_metrics.description: Securities and Exchange Commission: Revocation or suspension of broker-dealer or exchange member under the Securities Exchange Act (SEA) (statutory citation example: 15 USC 78o(b)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Suspension or withdrawal of registration
rubrics_metrics.description: Securities and Exchange Commission: Suspension or withdrawal of registration under the Securities Exchange Act (SEA) (statutory citations noted: 15 USC 78s(a), 78x(b)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Approval of sales, acquisitions, exemptions, or reorganization plans (PUHCA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Securities and Exchange Commission: Approval of sales, acquisitions, exemptions, or reorganization plans under PUHCA (statutory citations: 15 USC 79e,f,g,i,j,k,r).

rubrics_metrics.name: Exemption or other relief (ICA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Securities and Exchange Commission: Proceedings granting exemptions or other relief under the Investment Company Act (ICA) (statutory citation examples: various 15 USC sections).

rubrics_metrics.name: Investment advisers/IAA registration actions
rubrics_metrics.description: Securities and Exchange Commission: IAA registration (statutory citation example: 15 USC 80b-3).

rubrics_metrics.name: Disbarment (SA, SEA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Securities and Exchange Commission: Disbarment proceedings under the Securities Act and Securities Exchange Act (statutory citations include 15 USC sections such as 77s, 78x(a), etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Communist action / front / infiltrated organization proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Subversive Activities Control Board: Proceedings dealing with communist action, fronts, and infiltrated organizations (statutory citations: 50 USC 792, 792a).

rubrics_metrics.name: Suspension or revocation of marine (maritime) licenses
rubrics_metrics.description: Treasury Department / Coast Guard: Suspension or revocation of marine licenses (statutory citations: 46 USC 239, 239b).

rubrics_metrics.name: Agricultural marketing order contests
rubrics_metrics.description: Agriculture Department: Agricultural marketing order contests (statutory citation example: 7 USC 608c(15)(A)).

rubrics_metrics.name: CEA and P&S cease-and-desist proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Agriculture Department: Commodity Exchange Act (CEA) and Packer & Stockyards (P&S) cease-and-desist proceedings and related enforcement (statutory citations noted: 7 USC 13a, 193, 211).

rubrics_metrics.name: P&S license revocation or suspension and cease-and-desist orders
rubrics_metrics.description: Agriculture Department: Packer & Stockyards (P&S) license revocation or suspension and issuance of cease-and-desist orders (statutory citations: 7 USC 204, 205, 213, 218d appearing in the table).

rubrics_metrics.name: CEA suspension or revocation of registration and suspension of trading privileges
rubrics_metrics.description: Agriculture Department / CEA-related: Suspension or revocation of registration under the Commodity Exchange Act and suspension of trading privileges (statutory references appear in table entries).
